verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a local media CLI and library, but a transcoding tool could plausibly emit job or progress events as HTTP callbacks, so the webhooks axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event-subscription mechanism. The probes found no OpenAPI or API surface, and the docs describe only CLI transcoding, filtering and streaming features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
